trackerLog.subject: Asteria
trackerLog.focus: Acts, temples, two mains, eight main-side, single ending, death contingency

feature.notes: Roster is two mains (Cael, Liraen) plus eight main-side (Rook, Brann, Seris, Nym, Ash, Ysolde, Halric, Maera). Active battle three. See FEAT-027 through FEAT-036.

Do not close here. Split into FEAT-021 Mist, FEAT-022 Earth, FEAT-023 Water, FEAT-024 Fire, FEAT-025 Life, FEAT-026 Light. Mist cannot be cleared; Bengenia can be wiped (existing FEAT-003 discussion). User closes FEAT-003 after checking temple feats.

set.notes: Storyboard lives on FEAT-013 through FEAT-020. Single ending on FEAT-037.
Cast lock is now two mains plus eight main-side. Character feats FEAT-027 through FEAT-036.

feature.title: Act 0 — Padon / WillowDale
feature.notes: Prologue. Cael on the harvest road. Distant Cannon tick. First mist that does not belong. Title card. No deaths.

feature.title: Act 1 — Breskshire, Meddos, Timshaw, Iron's Gate
feature.notes: Human empire opening. Rook and Halric join. Liraen already on the Gate road. Ysolde may guest. First view of the Cannon. Crisis: Gate captain dies of heat with no fire.

feature.title: Act 2 — Constium, Temple of Earth, Cannon tour
feature.notes: Dwarf-rail in. Brann joins. Earth Sigil. Vortan is generous. Barrel aims at Fire, not at the Invasion. Brann death contingency exists after the shop-floor accident.

feature.title: Act 3 — Bengenia, Temple of Mist, Velith
feature.notes: West isle. Seris joins. Velith unmasked as smotherer, not Nyxara. FEAT-003: mist cannot be cleared. A major event can wipe Bengenia. That wipe is the Act 3 variation, not a second ending.

feature.title: Act 4 — Iunum, Valley of Songs, Queen's Cove, Temple of Water
feature.notes: King's Sea to the Elven Empire. Nym joins. Song-duel sideline. Airship framed, not flown. Water Sigil. Invasion smoke visible from the east cape.

feature.title: Act 5 — Orc Invasion, Brass Lands, Breakwoods, Temple of Fire
feature.notes: War front. Ash joins after the party refuses a Breskshire kill-order. Fire Sigil half-occupied. Nyxara's voice leaks. Ash and Halric have marked death crises.

feature.title: Act 6 — Tierso, Temple of Life, Temple of Light
feature.notes: South spine. Ysolde locks in. Maera joins at Light. Life and Light Sigils hold the Fissure shut; they do not power the Cannon. Choice preview only. Single ending still waits in Act 7.

feature.title: Act 7 — World Cannon, Maze Fissure, single ending
feature.notes: One ending: Nyxara sealed, Cannon spiked as a plug, temples rebound, world scarred and standing. Variations are who lives, whether Bengenia was wiped, Velith/Vortan fate, and fight texture. See FEAT-037.

feature.title: Temple of Mist — weather, form, visibility
feature.notes: Bengenia. Aspect: standing mist, form, what can be seen or named. Cannot be cleared. A major event can wipe the Pale Kingdom region. Sigil: Veil.

feature.title: Temple of Earth — stone, rail, seismic hold
feature.notes: Constium highlands. Aspect: mountains, rails, foundations, the ground under industry. If Earth fails, Constium works slump and the Cannon listing changes. Sigil: Keystone.

feature.title: Temple of Water — tide, river, King's Sea
feature.notes: East cape above Queen's Cove. Aspect: tides, rain, ferry lanes, flood and drought. If Water fails, King's Sea travel becomes a crisis. Sigil: Undertow.

feature.title: Temple of Fire — heat, forge, Nyxara's leak
feature.notes: North under the Cannon shadow. Aspect: heat, forge-fire, volcanic breath, the hunger under the Fissure. Corruption here is Nyxara speaking through prayer. Sigil: Cinder.

feature.title: Temple of Life — harvest, healing, blight
feature.notes: South of King's Sea, above Tierso. Aspect: crops, birth, field healing, plague. If Life fails, Breskshire and Tierso starve on a timer. Sigil: Root.

feature.title: Temple of Light — day, oath, southern beacon
feature.notes: Far south near Tierso. Aspect: day-cycle, sworn oaths, navigation, the last honest beacon. If Light fails, maps and vows both drift. Sigil: Meridian.

feature.title: Main — Cael Ward (M, plot armor)
feature.notes: Padon / Iron's Gate squire. Male lead. Cannot die. Late suggestive romance with Liraen (FEAT-028). Blade that later accepts a Cannon-sigil as a seal, not a gun.

feature.title: Main — Liraen Quill (F, plot armor)
feature.notes: Iunum / Valley of Songs. Female lead. Cannot die. Late suggestive romance with Cael (FEAT-027). Bard-ranger. Party memory and song-duel owner.

feature.title: Main-side — Rook Fenn
feature.notes: Meddos / Timshaw. Knives and roads. Joins Act 1. Killable at the Timshaw levy riot or the Act 5 camp raid. Contingency: stolen writs still exist as documents.

feature.title: Main-side — Brann Dur
feature.notes: Constium Cannon shop floor. Hammer and gauges. Joins Act 2. Killable at the shop-floor accident or the Act 7 barrel climb. Contingency: his gauging book remains.

feature.title: Main-side — Seris Vale
feature.notes: Bengenia, Temple of Mist. Mist adept. Joins Act 3. Killable in the Bengenia wipe or Velith confrontation. Contingency: Veil Sigil can be recovered from the ruin.

feature.title: Main-side — Nym Hale
feature.notes: Queen's Cove machinist-gunner. Joins Act 4. Killable at the Cove dock fire. Contingency: airship frame can be finished from her notes by a Cove NPC.

feature.title: Main-side — Ash Korv
feature.notes: Breakwoods / Brass Lands half-orc beast-knight. Joins Act 5. Killable if the party takes the Breskshire kill-order or fails the holdfast defense. Contingency: Invasion route still opens.

feature.title: Main-side — Ysolde Rhea
feature.notes: Tierso / Temple of Life cleric-alchemist. Guest in Act 1 optional. Locks in Act 6. Killable at the Life blight ward. Contingency: Root Sigil via Maera or temple remnant.

feature.title: Main-side — Halric Bent
feature.notes: Iron's Gate / Breskshire heavy knight. Cael's foil. Joins Act 1. Killable at Gate heat-death scene (if he covers Cael) or Act 5 front. Contingency: Gate command passes to an unnamed captain.

feature.title: Main-side — Maera Sol
feature.notes: Temple of Light acolyte, Tierso isthmus. Joins Act 6. Killable at the Light beacon collapse. Contingency: Meridian Sigil can be taken from the beacon itself.

feature.title: Single ending, few route variations
feature.notes: One ending thesis. Variations change survivors, scars, and the last fight's texture. They do not fork into a second ending cinematic.

feature.title: Avoidable character death with contingency
feature.notes: Main-side deaths are possible at marked crises and normally avoidable. Game continues. Cael and Liraen cannot die.

trackerLog.decision: Single ending. Variations change who lives, whether Bengenia is wiped, Velith and Vortan fate, and final-fight texture. No second ending cinematic.
Cael Ward (M) and Liraen Quill (F) cannot die. Late romance is suggestive, not explicit, FF7/FF8 grade.
Main-side deaths are possible at marked crises, normally avoidable, and always have a contingency so the act continues.
Each temple governs a world aspect. Mist cannot be cleared. A major event can wipe Bengenia.
Halric Bent and Maera Sol added so the main-side count is eight beside the two leads.
trackerLog.note: Acts FEAT-013..020. Temples FEAT-021..026. Mains FEAT-027 Cael, FEAT-028 Liraen. Main-side FEAT-029..036. Ending FEAT-037. Death FEAT-038. Next feat 39.
